transaction_extraction.task: Extract transaction data from Bank of China (BOC) account history with bilingual headers
column_order: 凭证号业务号用途摘要

column_descriptions.交易类型: Transaction type (Type), like '小额普通', '代发划转', '收费'
column_descriptions.凭证号业务号用途摘要: Voucher No./Trans. No./Details - combined field containing transaction details
column_descriptions.借方发生额: Debit amount (outgoing), may be empty if credit
column_descriptions.贷方发生额: Credit amount (incoming), may be empty if debit
column_descriptions.备注: Notes, may contain counterparty info like company name

extraction_rules: Headers are bilingual Chinese/English - focus on Chinese labels
Skip header rows containing column names
Skip footer summary rows (借方合计, 贷方合计)
记账日 format is YYMMDD, convert to YYYY-MM-DD if needed
借方发生额 and 贷方发生额 are mutually exclusive (one will be empty)
凭证号业务号用途摘要 may span multiple lines - merge them
备注 column contains counterparty information
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

summary_extraction.task: Extract summary information from Bank of China statement header
summary_extraction.location: Summary info in page header only

target_fields.账号: Account No. - found in page header
target_fields.账户名称: Account Name - company or individual name
target_fields.账户类型: Account Type - like '单位人民币活期基本账户'

extraction_rules: Header fields are labeled with both Chinese and English
Only extract from page header, ignore footer totals
Account info from header is consistent across pages
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values
